bestiary.toast.title: NEW FIELD KNOWLEDGE
bestiary.discovery.foxbear.territorial: Field note: territorial pressure increases when the Hunter loses space.
bestiary.weak_point.discovered: Weak point confirmed in field observations.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.dummy_ene: A controlled opponent used to verify perception and combat timing.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.dummy_en: Acquires a valid target, remembers it briefly, and advances through explicit attack phases.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.dummy_enem: Watch the windup, leave the hitbox, and exploit recovery. Stagger is independent of knockback.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.foxbear: A heavy territorial creature. Read the marks on the ground before crossing a clearing.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.foxbear: It patrols its territory and presses intruders with its weight. The danger grows when space disappears.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.foxbear: Claw swipes, a bite and a short charge have been observed. Do not let it corner you.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.great_sta: A charging predator that dominates open ground.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.great_st: It keeps close distance and advances in a straight line.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.great_stam: The charge is dangerous; wait for the opening after it misses.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.frog_in_w: A buried ambusher waiting for prey to pass.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.frog_in_: It stays hidden until movement enters its range.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.frog_in_wa: Watch the ground and keep clear of its emergence area.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.master_of: A large aquatic predator with a wide territory.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.master_o: It uses water to hide its approach and control space.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.master_of_: Fighting it requires room; shallow water is not safety.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.kiriko: A disguised creature that can look human at a distance.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.kiriko: It imitates travelers and waits for a hunter to relax.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.man_faced: An imitator that uses a familiar silhouette to ambush.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.man_face: It stays inconspicuous until its target loses caution.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.man_faced_: Do not mistake a humanoid shape for safety.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.spider_ea: An aerial hunter that turns height into an advantage.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.spider_e: It circles above and dives when the moment is right.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.spider_eag: Open ground helps reveal the dive.

nenfoundation.vfx.ribbons_automatico: Ribbon count handed back to the profile.

nenfoundation.vfx.congelado: Aura FROZEN on the current frame.
nenfoundation.vfx.ajuste_forcado: Adjustment %s forced to %s. This is a hypothesis, not a decision: write it to the profile to make it real.
nenfoundation.vfx.ajuste_automatico: Adjustment %s handed back to the profile.
nenfoundation.vfx.captura_ligada: Capture mode ON: time and weather locked, HUD hidden, third person.

nenfoundation.vfx.lote_iniciado: Batch started under the label '%s'. Do not move until it finishes.
nenfoundation.vfx.lote_concluido: Batch finished: %s images in screenshots/%s. State handed back to the server.
